claim: For the complex \(D_{6,3}\) of simple graphs on six labeled vertices whose domination number is at least \(3\), \(D_{6,3}\simeq \bigvee^{115} S^4 \vee \bigvee^{24} S^5\).

correctness.rationale: An explicit staged discrete-Morse matching on the full finite complex has one critical 0-cell, 115 critical 4-cells, and 24 critical 5-cells; exhaustive Hasse-DAG checking proves acyclicity. Exact integer algebraic Morse cancellation gives zero differential from critical 5-cells to critical 4-cells. The resulting 4-skeleton is a wedge of 115 four-spheres, and Hurewicz makes the zero cellular boundary sufficient to null-homotope every 5-cell attaching map. Independent full-chain ranks over F2 and F3 agree with the resulting homology. The only non-computational inputs are standard finite discrete Morse theory and the Hurewicz theorem.
